name: cloud-native-kubernetes-patterns
description: Use when the user asks about sidecar or native sidecar containers, ambassador/adapter/init patterns, PodDisruptionBudget, topology spread, pod anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, graceful shutdown, or ValidatingAdmissionPolicy. Produces current-API workload YAML. Not for control-plane internals (use kubernetes-internals) or autoscaling (use devops-kubernetes-autoscaling).
